c74object.name: syncSuite.video.source
c74object.digest: Utility for rendering textures, matrices, playing video files and compositing controls.
c74object.description: It allows intelligent loading and playback of video files, texture processing such as cropping, inserting fx, among others operations. It is designed to work with the syncSuite Max4Live devices for video syncronization with Ableton Live.

inlet.description: Accepts every message described below. Also accepts a jit_matrix or jit_gl_texture directly, which is rendered instead of the internal movie player whenever the "source" attribute is set to "external".
Only relevant while "enableInsert" is on: feeds the matrix/texture returning from an external FX chain back into the object for final display. See "enableInsert" below.

outlet.description: Only active while "enableInsert" is on: outputs the current texture/matrix so it can be run through an external FX chain before being fed back into the second inlet. Silent while "enableInsert" is off (default), since the object renders internally instead.

objarg.name: context
objarg.digest: Name of the syncSuite.video.context to render into
objarg.description: Required. Names the rendering context this source draws into, same as the @drawto attribute and the "drawto"/"context" messages. If omitted, the object has no render context ("NONE") and posts a warning to the Max window until one is set.

method.name: read
method.digest: Loads and plays a movie file directly
method.description: With a "filename" argument, loads and plays that movie immediately on the current player. With no argument, opens a file-choose dialog.

method.name: addMovie
method.digest: Adds a movie to the playlist
method.description: Adds "filename" (a file in the search path, or a full path) to the object's internal playlist, without loading it into memory yet - use "current_video" or "next_video" to actually load a video that's been added. With no argument, opens a file-choose dialog. "addMovie clear" empties the playlist. Movies belonging to the current Ableton Live Project are added automatically this way by the companion Max4Live device once connected.

method.name: current_video
method.digest: Sets and plays the current video
method.description: Switches playback to "filename" (previously added with "addMovie"). Internally the object double-buffers two movie players and swaps between them, so if "filename" was already preloaded via "next_video" the swap happens with zero delay. Often paired with "time_ms" in the same message, e.g. "current_video <file>, time_ms 0".

method.name: next_video
method.description: Loads "filename" into the currently inactive player, ready for an instantaneous swap the next time "current_video" selects it.

method.name: time_ms
method.description: Moves the current video's playback position to "milliseconds" and starts playing from there. See "goto" for seeking without starting.

method.name: goto
method.description: Moves the current video's playback position to "milliseconds" without changing its running/stopped state. See "time_ms" to seek and start together.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts (or resumes) playing the current video.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the current video.

method.name: loop
method.description: When enabled (1), the current video loops automatically at end-of-file instead of stopping. Forwarded to the internal movie player's own "loop" attribute; also settable as "@loop" at creation.

method.name: black
method.description: Stops playback and swaps in a solid black matrix, blanking the rendered output.

method.name: clear
method.description: Disposes of the current player's loaded movie and resets its state.

method.name: source
method.digest: Chooses between the internal movie player and external input
method.description: "internal" (default) renders the object's own movie playback chain. "external" stops rendering the movie chain and instead renders whatever jit_matrix or jit_gl_texture is fed into the first inlet, while still going through the same cropping, projection and FX-insert pipeline the movie player uses.

method.name: autoRatio
method.digest: Automatically preserves the source's aspect ratio
method.description: When enabled (1), scale is computed automatically from the source's native dimensions against "dimComposite", preserving its aspect ratio. Only meaningful when "projectionMode" is 0 (UV space); in pixel space (1) dimensions are already pixel-exact and autoRatio has no effect. Default 0.

method.name: dimSource
method.description: Tells the object the pixel dimensions of the incoming source, used together with "dimComposite" for aspect-ratio math (see "autoRatio"). Normally read automatically from a loaded movie file; set this explicitly when using "source external" with a matrix/texture whose dimensions aren't otherwise known.

method.name: dimComposite
method.description: Reference width and height, in pixels, of the destination composite - used for aspect-ratio calculations ("autoRatio") and pixel-space positioning. Default 1920 1080.

method.name: scale
method.description: Sets the videoplane's scale on both axes at once. Default 1. See "scaleX"/"scaleY" to scale each axis independently.

method.name: scaleX
method.description: Sets only the x scale, leaving y unchanged.

method.name: scaleY
method.description: Sets only the y scale, leaving x unchanged.

method.name: position
method.digest: Positions the video in UV space
method.description: Places the video at the normalized (-1. to 1.) position x, y. Used when "projectionMode" is 0 (UV space); see "positionInPixels" for pixel space.

method.name: positionInPixels
method.digest: Positions the video in pixel space
method.description: Places the video at pixel position x, y, with 0, 0 at the top-left pixel of the texture. Used when "projectionMode" is 1 (pixel space).

method.name: rotatexyz
method.digest: Rotates the video around x, y and z
method.description: Sets the videoplane's rotation, in degrees, around each axis.

method.name: layer
method.description: Forwarded to the internal videoplane's "layer" attribute, controlling draw/compositing order within the destination context.

method.name: cropTop
method.description: Crops the texture from the top edge by "amount", via a custom cropping shader.

method.name: cropBottom
method.description: Crops the texture from the bottom edge by "amount", via a custom cropping shader.

method.name: cropLeft
method.description: Crops the texture from the left edge by "amount", via a custom cropping shader.

method.name: cropRight
method.description: Crops the texture from the right edge by "amount", via a custom cropping shader.

method.name: enableInsert
method.digest: Routes the video through an external FX chain
method.description: When disabled (0, default), the object renders and displays the video internally, and the outlet stays silent. When enabled (1), the current texture/matrix is sent out the outlet instead of being displayed, letting it be patched through external Jitter FX objects; the result must be patched back into the second inlet, which feeds directly into the internal display chain, closing the insert loop.

method.name: enable
method.description: Enables (1) or disables (0) the object's rendering.

method.name: projectionMode
method.digest: Switches between UV space and pixel space
method.description: 0 (default) positions/scales the video in OpenGL's normalized UV space; 1 switches to an absolute pixel space for exact-pixel compositing/video-mapping (see "positionInPixels"). Must match the "projectionMode" set on the destination syncSuite.video.context. See syncSuite.video.context for a full explanation of the two projection modes.

method.name: windowSizeToDimComposite
method.digest: Ties dimComposite to the render window's size
method.description: When enabled (1), "dimComposite" is kept automatically in sync with the destination context's current window size, instead of being set manually.

method.name: drawto
method.description: Changes which syncSuite.video.context this source draws into. Same mechanism as the creation argument.

method.name: context
method.description: Identical to "drawto": sets the destination rendering context. See "drawto" above.

method.name: toVideoPlane
method.digest: Sends a message straight to the internal videoplane/layer
method.description: Forwards "method" and any following arguments directly to the internal jit.gl.videoplane/jit.gl.layer object, e.g. "toVideoPlane blend_mode 1 1" or "toVideoPlane scale 0.5 0.5 0.". Use this to reach jit.gl.layer attributes not otherwise exposed as top-level messages on this object.

attribute.name: drawto
attribute.description: Same as the "drawto"/"context" messages and the creation argument. Default "NONE" (no context set); a warning is posted to the Max window until a real context is given.

attribute.name: autoRatio
attribute.digest: Automatically preserves the source's aspect ratio

attribute.name: enableInsert
attribute.digest: Routes the video through an external FX chain

attribute.name: windowSizeToDimComposite
attribute.digest: Ties dimComposite to the render window's size

c74object.discussion:
For its most basic use, syncSuite.video.source is a wrapper around jit.gl.movie and jit.gl.layer (via an internal jit.gl.videoplane), and it inherits their compositing and processing features on top of the custom ones documented above. Attributes and messages not exposed directly on this object can still be reached with "toVideoPlane <method> <args...>", forwarded straight to the internal videoplane/layer.
Under the hood the object double-buffers two movie players so that "next_video" can preload the next file while the current one keeps playing, making the swap on "current_video" instantaneous. When paired with the companion Max4Live device, movies belonging to the current Ableton Live Project are added automatically via "addMovie", and the device can drive playback in sync with Live's transport.
